sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi, Daily Team.
sentences.zh: 嗨，每日团队。

sentences.en: From the New York Times,
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: You know, I don't have to be the first one to say that 2020 was rough, but 2020 has been a really crazy year for everybody.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不必第一个说 2020 年很艰难，但对每个人来说，2020 年确实是极其疯狂的一年。

sentences.en: There's been a lot of really, really hard moments, but there's been a lot of really beautiful ones, too.
sentences.zh: 有过很多非常非常艰难的时刻，但也有很多非常美好的时刻。

sentences.en: You asked if anything good has happened throughout 2020.
sentences.zh: 你问过 2020 年期间有没有发生过什么好事。

sentences.en: Today, some good news from 2020 from daily listeners all over the world.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将分享来自世界各地《每日新闻》听众的 2020 年好消息。

sentences.en: And I squealed when I heard that you're looking for people to talk about something good that happened to them during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 当我听说你们在找人讲述大流行期间发生在他身上的好事时，我兴奋得尖叫起来。

sentences.en: Here's one.
sentences.zh: 这是一个。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, December 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是 12 月 23 日，星期三。

sentences.en: This is Bess from Milwaukee, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我是来自威斯康星州密尔沃基的贝丝。

sentences.en: My very small 2020 win is that I finally allotted some of my graduate school budget to buy a vacuum cleaner so I wouldn't have to keep lint rolling my floors.
sentences.zh: 我 2020 年微不足道的胜利是，我终于从研究生院的预算里拨出一部分钱买了一个吸尘器，这样我就不用一直用粘毛滚筒清理地板了。

sentences.en: I got a job teaching English in Bali, which is pretty sick.
sentences.zh: 我找到了一份在巴厘岛教英语的工作，这太酷了。

sentences.en: I don't think I had a lot of competition because it's hard to get into the country right now, but I'm pretty excited.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的竞争不大，因为现在很难进入这个国家，但我非常兴奋。

sentences.en: I have been knitting a scarf on and off for five years.
sentences.zh: 我织围巾织得断断续续，已经五年了。

sentences.en: I finally get to finish it this year after I graduated from college this summer and was waiting around in New York City to start grad school.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天我大学毕业，在纽约市等待开始读研究生，今年我终于把它织完了。

sentences.en: This year, during the COVID-19 pandemic, I decided to take up the trumpet.
sentences.zh: 今年，在 COVID-19 大流行期间，我决定开始学小号。

sentences.en: Katie, this year I went from working from home at a job I had for three and a half years to my dream job working as a contact tracer for the Department of
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，今年我从在家办公、做了一年半的工作，换成了我梦寐以求的工作——在

sentences.en: Health.
sentences.zh: 卫生部门担任密接追踪员。

sentences.en: My name's Ty.
sentences.zh: 我叫泰.

sentences.en: I'm from Arkansas.
sentences.zh: 我来自阿肯色州。

sentences.en: And during quarantine, I've been making art.
sentences.zh: 在隔离期间，我一直在创作艺术。

sentences.en: Not sure if anyone else likes it, but I'm having fun.
sentences.zh: 不确定其他人是否喜欢，但我玩得很开心。

sentences.en: My name is Mario Alberghini and I'm from San Juan, Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 我叫马里奥·阿尔贝吉尼，来自波多黎各圣胡安。

sentences.en: I have a luxury menswear shop and custom clothing store.
sentences.zh: 我经营着一家奢侈男装店和定制服装店。

sentences.en: In March, we had to go into a complete shutdown and it really seemed like this was it for us.
sentences.zh: 三月份，我们不得不全面停业，这看起来确实是我们走投无路的时候。

sentences.en: But in an unprecedented turn of events, all of my competition is gone.
sentences.zh: 但在一次前所未有的事件中，我所有的竞争对手都消失了。

sentences.en: The multinational chains like Brooks Brothers and Nordstrom's, they left the island and they have basically created a void, which we have been able to fill.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克斯兄弟和诺德斯特龙这样的跨国连锁店退出了这个岛，它们基本上留下了真空，而我们填补了这个空白。

sentences.en: This quarantine, I can't lie, I got really good at poaching eggs.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这次隔离期间，我水煮蛋的技术变得非常高超。

sentences.en: So now it's just recording and then we'll just cut the part that's only you talking.
sentences.zh: 所以现在只需录制，然后我们就会剪掉只有你说话的部分。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Jim Shuler.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是吉姆·舒勒。

sentences.en: I'm a 76-year-old grandpa from Peoria, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 我是来自亚利桑那州皮奥里亚的 76 岁爷爷。

sentences.en: The good thing that happened to me this year because of the quarantine is that I was able to ride my bicycle almost every day.
sentences.zh: 今年因为隔离发生在我身上的好事是，我几乎每天都能骑自行车。

sentences.en: I'm closing in on 8,000 miles for this year.
sentences.zh: 我今年的骑行里程正逼近 8000 英里。

sentences.en: If I did have to pick out something that I'm particularly proud about, it's battling and
sentences.zh: 如果要挑出一件我特别自豪的事情，那就是对抗并

sentences.en: I think emerging victorious from an eating disorder that's gripped me for nearly a year by now.
sentences.zh: 我认为自己战胜了已经折磨我近一年的进食障碍，取得了胜利。

sentences.en: It's been pretty difficult to try going back to a normal state, but I found support and love from so many people that I didn't expect before.
sentences.zh: 回归正常状态相当不容易，但我从许多意想不到的人那里得到了支持和爱。

sentences.en: A year after his surgery, my husband's MRI revealed that his brain tumor did not return.
sentences.zh: 手术一年后，我丈夫的核磁共振检查显示他的脑瘤没有复发。

sentences.en: My name is Carmen and I'm 21 years old.
sentences.zh: 我叫卡门，今年 21 岁。

sentences.en: 2020 helped me become the strongest person I have ever been.
sentences.zh: 2020 年帮助我成为了我所经历过的最坚强的人。

sentences.en: I've been seeing a therapist for the first time in my entire life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子第一次去看心理医生。

sentences.en: After 30 years of professional business travel, lots of red eyes, international flights, lots of status on airlines, I finally stopped.
sentences.zh: 经过 30 年的商务差旅、无数次红眼航班、国际航班和各家航空公司的尊贵会员身份，我终于停下来了。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Holly from Virginia and I was just calling about my seven-year-old son, Thor, who has had the best year of his life.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是来自弗吉尼亚州的霍莉，我打电话是想说说我七岁的儿子索尔，他度过了他一生中最棒的一年。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hey, Thor, it's Luke from The Daily.
sentences.zh: 嘿，索尔，我是《每日新闻》的卢克。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: That's a pretty cool name.
sentences.zh: 这个名字挺酷的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So, Thor, I heard that you had like a pretty good 2020.
sentences.zh: 索尔，我听说你的 2020 年过得相当不错。

sentences.en: Is that true?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about it?
sentences.zh: 能跟我讲讲吗？

sentences.en: Last year, I didn't feel good and I had to lay on the couch and I couldn't play with my friends.
sentences.zh: 去年我感觉很不舒服，不得不躺在沙发上，不能和我的朋友们一起玩。

sentences.en: This year, I take this medicine every 30 days at CHKD and it helps me.
sentences.zh: 今年，我每 30 天在 CHKD 服用一次这种药，它对我有帮助。

sentences.en: And now I'm feeling better and I have energy and I've been doing races and I'm in the one mile and my best time is 8-19.
sentences.zh: 现在我感觉好多了，也有精力了，我一直在参加跑步比赛，我参加了一英里赛，我的最好成绩是 8 分 19 秒。

sentences.en: Whoa, really?
sentences.zh: 哇，真的吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Is that one of your favorite things to do?
sentences.zh: 这是你最喜欢做的事情之一吗？

sentences.en: Do you like running?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢跑步吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, what other favorite things do you like to do?
sentences.zh: 哦，你还喜欢做什么其他的事情？

sentences.en: I like to play with my brother.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢和我的兄弟一起玩。

sentences.en: So, last night we were getting ready for his infusion this month and he just said like what an awesome year 2020 is.
sentences.zh: 所以，昨晚我们正为他本月的输液做准备，他刚说 2020 年是多么棒的一年。

sentences.en: So, we are very thankful for all the nurses at CHKD in the Blood and Cancer Center and all the doctors.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们非常感谢血液和癌症中心的 CHKD 的所有护士和所有医生。

sentences.en: They have been there faithfully during a pandemic making sure kids get their life-saving medicine and we're forever grateful.
sentences.zh: 在大流行期间，他们一直坚守岗位，确保孩子们获得救命的药物，我们永远心存感激。

sentences.en: Bye, Thor.
sentences.zh: 再见，索尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收看《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当 DJ 的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天都要带 300 件你最珍贵的藏品去上班，你把 DJ 台变成了一个精美的 50 年前艺术品的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼推出的《重构者》。

sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》，立即下载时报应用程序，即可免费享受 30 天的使用权限。

sentences.en: Hello there.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: My bit of good news for the year was directly after I got my PS5.
sentences.zh: 我今年遇到的一件好事发生在我刚买到 PS5 之后。

sentences.en: I thought the year was going to peak right there.
sentences.zh: 我以为这一年也就到此达到顶峰了。

sentences.en: But it turns out I got a PS5 and a girlfriend for 2020.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，在 2020 年我不仅得到了 PS5，还收获了女朋友。

sentences.en: How you like that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这怎么样？

sentences.en: I met Andrew at the end of May for Match.com because that's how millennials date.
sentences.zh: 我和安德鲁是在 5 月底通过 Match.com 认识的，因为千禧一代就是这样约会的。

sentences.en: I met someone who started dating.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一个开始约会的人。

sentences.en: I met someone I really liked, but he ghosted me.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一个我很喜欢的人，但他却把我甩了（人间蒸发）。

sentences.en: I was going on a second date with a guy and he didn't show up.
sentences.zh: 我正和一个男生进行第二次约会，结果他没出现。

sentences.en: The next day I googled him and then all these articles came up that said he had been arrested on the day of our second date.
sentences.zh: 第二天我谷歌搜索了他，然后弹出了所有文章，上面说他在我们第二次约会的当天被捕了。

sentences.en: So that was crazy.
sentences.zh: 所以这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: But then a few weeks later I started messaging with a guy named Dan on Bumble.
sentences.zh: 但几周后，我开始在 Bumble 上和一个叫丹的男生聊天。

sentences.en: We met on January 2nd, 2020.
sentences.zh: 我们在 2020 年 1 月 2 日见面了。

sentences.en: And since then we've spent pretty much every day together and it's been the beSt.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我们几乎每天都在一起，这是最棒的。

sentences.en: My name is Adel and my good news for 2020 is I found the woman I want to spend the rest of my life with.
sentences.zh: 我叫阿德尔，我 2020 年的好消息是我找到了我想共度余生的女人。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Hera and my good news for 2020 is that I met Adel.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫赫拉，我 2020 年的好消息是我遇到了阿德尔。

sentences.en: I think that I met my future husband.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我遇到了我未来的丈夫。

sentences.en: I fell in love.
sentences.zh: 我坠入爱河了。

sentences.en: I fell in love.
sentences.zh: 我坠入爱河了。

sentences.en: I fell in love with my best friend.
sentences.zh: 我与我最好的朋友坠入爱河了。

sentences.en: I think the first time he smiled at me, I knew that I was in trouble.
sentences.zh: 我想当他第一次向我微笑时，我就知道我要沦陷了。

sentences.en: Baby, I love you so much and I want to spend the rest of my life with you.
sentences.zh: 宝贝，我太爱你了，我想和你共度余生。

sentences.en: Baby, will you marry me?
sentences.zh: 宝贝，你愿意嫁给我吗？

sentences.en: I didn't hear you.
sentences.zh: 我没听清。

sentences.en: You have to say it.
sentences.zh: 你必须说出来。

sentences.en: Can I put this on for you?
sentences.zh: 我可以把这个戴上吗？

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: I got engaged in April of this year.
sentences.zh: 我在今年四月订婚了。

sentences.en: I had always told him that I didn't want to get married and that if I changed my mind, I would ask him.
sentences.zh: 我以前总是告诉他我不想结婚，如果我改变主意了，我会向他求婚。

sentences.en: So that's what I did.
sentences.zh: 所以我就是这么做的。

sentences.en: I got engaged.
sentences.zh: 我订婚了。

sentences.en: I'm getting married.
sentences.zh: 我要结婚了。

sentences.en: This is Chris from Puke, Verena, North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 这是来自北卡罗来纳州维雷娜普克的克里斯。

sentences.en: In 2017, me and my wife got married and that following year in spring of 2018, we started to try and have a baby.
sentences.zh: 2017 年，我和我妻子结婚了，第二年即 2018 年春天，我们开始尝试要一个孩子。

sentences.en: And there were quite a few roadblocks that we encountered, fertility specialists, so on.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了相当多的阻碍，生育专家等等。

sentences.en: And this Monday, I came downstairs to head to work and my wife was at the kitchen table with a positive pregnancy teSt.
sentences.zh: 而这个星期一，我下楼准备去上班，我妻子正坐在厨房桌旁，拿着验孕棒显示阳性。

sentences.en: It's the world to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说意味着全世界。

sentences.en: It's honestly really made this year worth it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这真的让今年变得值得。

sentences.en: We are both so happy and so thrilled.
sentences.zh: 我们都非常高兴和兴奋。

sentences.en: We just can't wait to have a family.
sentences.zh: 我们简直迫不及待地想要一个家庭。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Leslie Koretz and I live in Milton, Ontario, Canada.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是莱斯利·科雷茨，我住在加拿大安大略省米尔顿。

sentences.en: And the best thing that happened to me this year was the birth of my son, Nathan, on February 10th.
sentences.zh: 今年发生在我身上最好的事是 2 月 10 日我的儿子内森出生了。

sentences.en: So he's 10 months old today.
sentences.zh: 所以他今天 10 个月大了。

sentences.en: My wife and I welcomed our first son this year.
sentences.zh: 我和妻子今年迎来了我们的第一个儿子。

sentences.en: We welcomed twins in February of this year.
sentences.zh: 我们在今年 2 月迎来了双胞胎。

sentences.en: I had a baby girl.
sentences.zh: 我生了一个女孩。

sentences.en: A baby boy.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩。

sentences.en: We welcomed our first baby.
sentences.zh: 我们迎来了我们的第一个宝宝。

sentences.en: Our first child.
sentences.zh: 我们的第一个孩子。

sentences.en: Isabel.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔。

sentences.en: Lucy May.
sentences.zh: 露西·梅。

sentences.en: Sophia.
sentences.zh: 索菲亚。

sentences.en: Maeve Lillian.
sentences.zh: 梅芙·莉莲。

sentences.en: Enuma Elish.
sentences.zh: 埃努玛·埃利什。

sentences.en: We called him Goose for short.
sentences.zh: 我们简称他为鹅。

sentences.en: Can you say anything?
sentences.zh: 你能说点什么吗？

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Isabella.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫伊莎贝拉。

sentences.en: I'm from Centerville, Virginia.
sentences.zh: 我来自弗吉尼亚州森特维尔。

sentences.en: My older sister has two parakeets, Doodle and Gus.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐有两只长尾小鹦鹉，杜德尔和格斯。

sentences.en: And over quarantine, Doodle has been giving birth to so many eggs.
sentences.zh: 在隔离期间，杜德尔生了好多蛋。

sentences.en: Her count is probably up to 12 by now.
sentences.zh: 她的数量到现在大概已经达到12个了。

sentences.en: And she's super old and has never laid eggs before.
sentences.zh: 而且她年纪非常大，以前从来没有下过蛋。

sentences.en: So this came as a huge surprise.
sentences.zh: 所以这真是一个巨大的惊喜。

sentences.en: And I guess it's a 2020 miracle.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是2020年的一大奇迹吧。

sentences.en: Hey, this is Will from Western Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是来自麻省西部的威尔。

sentences.en: I'm a doctor out here.
sentences.zh: 我是一名这里的医生。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, we've had to quarantine from most people because of that.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，因为这个原因，我们不得不跟大多数人进行隔离。

sentences.en: And things have been really difficult this year.
sentences.zh: 今年情况真的很艰难。

sentences.en: Like, they have been for lots of people.
sentences.zh: 就像对很多人来说一样。

sentences.en: But at one point, right when I was getting ready to go to work, about 6.30 p.m., I'm a nocturniSt.
sentences.zh: 但有一次，就在我准备去上班的时候，大约傍晚6点半，我是个夜班医生。

sentences.en: And my wife's feeling frustrated and a little lonely, totally understandably.
sentences.zh: 我妻子感到沮丧又有点孤单，完全可以理解。

sentences.en: Our daughter, who's, I don't know how many months old at that point, but a little over a year, just decided to stand up and walk across the living room for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我们的女儿，当时我不知道她具体几个月大，但刚过一岁，突然决定站起来，第一次走过了客厅。

sentences.en: And it was like this magical being from another universe just kind of, like, entered the house and became ambulatory.
sentences.zh: 那感觉就像来自另一个宇宙的神奇生物突然进入了屋子，而且能行走了。

sentences.en: And we both started tearing up, kind of laughing hysterically.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都开始飙泪，还有点歇斯底里地笑了起来。

sentences.en: It was like this kind of tear in the fabric of our day-to-day life that was so welcome.
sentences.zh: 这就像在我们日常生活织体上开了一个裂口，来得太及时了。

sentences.en: I developed quite a strong relationship with my daughter, who is a teenager.
sentences.zh: 我和我正处于青春期的女儿建立了相当深厚的关系。

sentences.en: She's at that age where it's hard to have fun with me anymore because we don't share a lot of same interests.
sentences.zh: 她正处在这个很难再跟我玩到一块儿的年纪，因为我们没有太多共同的兴趣。

sentences.en: But for some reason, in the manic of the pandemic lockdown, we started talking to each other in horrible, fake British accents.
sentences.zh: 但不知为什么，在大流行封锁的疯狂中，我们开始用可怕的假英国口音跟对方说话。

sentences.en: And now we love each other's company because we spend the entire time cracking up.
sentences.zh: 现在我们特别喜欢彼此的陪伴，因为我们把所有时间都花在狂笑上了。

sentences.en: My name is Nancy Haas, and I live in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 我叫南希·哈斯，我住在费城。

sentences.en: One of the reasons I moved here was because my daughter lived here.
sentences.zh: 我搬到这里的原因之一就是因为我女儿住在这里。

sentences.en: My daughter and I are not close.
sentences.zh: 我和女儿并不亲近。

sentences.en: And the reason we weren't close was because I said a really stupid thing to her.
sentences.zh: 我们不亲近的原因是我对她说过一句非常蠢的话。

sentences.en: And then another piece of history is that my mom once said something to me that was, to me, a heinous remark.
sentences.zh: 还有一段历史是，我妈妈曾经对我说过一句话，对我而言，那是一句十恶不赦的话。

sentences.en: That I was just, I am not forgiving her for this.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，我绝对不会原谅她。

sentences.en: And I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我也确实没有原谅。

sentences.en: And I never shared deeply with her again, sadly, until I was much older.
sentences.zh: 而且很遗憾，直到我年纪大得多之前，我再也没有向她敞开过心扉。

sentences.en: So, COVID hits.
sentences.zh: 然后，新冠疫情爆发了。

sentences.en: And I'm kind of losing it a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我有点快要崩溃了。

sentences.en: I'm very frightened.
sentences.zh: 我非常害怕。

sentences.en: And one day, at around 5 o'clock, I get a FaceTime call.
sentences.zh: 有一天，大约5点钟，我接到一个FaceTime视频电话。

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh my God, it's Kat.
sentences.zh: 我说，噢天哪，是凯特。

sentences.en: I wonder what's wrong with her.
sentences.zh: 我在想她怎么了。

sentences.en: Because, like, why is she calling me?
sentences.zh: 因为，怎么说呢，她为什么会给我打电话？

sentences.en: Like, we barely talk.
sentences.zh: 我们平时几乎不怎么聊天。

sentences.en: And there we are seeing each other.
sentences.zh: 然后我们在屏幕里看到了彼此。

sentences.en: And I'm like, hey, you okay?
sentences.zh: 我说，嘿，你还好吗？

sentences.en: And she goes, hi, Mommy.
sentences.zh: 她说，嗨，妈咪。

sentences.en: And I said, she's calling me Mommy.
sentences.zh: 我说，她叫我妈咪耶。

sentences.en: I said, hey, sweetie, is everything okay?
sentences.zh: 我说，嘿，亲爱的，一切都好吗？

sentences.en: She goes, yes.
sentences.zh: 她说，挺好的。

sentences.en: And I said, what's up?
sentences.zh: 我说，怎么啦？

sentences.en: And she goes, nothing.
sentences.zh: 她说，没事啊。

sentences.en: I just thought I would call you to talk.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得想打个电话跟你聊聊天。

sentences.en: And I'm like, okay.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧。

sentences.en: I said, what you doing?
sentences.zh: 我说，你在干嘛呢？

sentences.en: She goes, well, I'm cooking.
sentences.zh: 她说，嗯，我在做饭呢。

sentences.en: So, I'm like, so do you want me to keep you company?
sentences.zh: 我说，那你希望我陪陪你吗？

sentences.en: And she goes, okay.
sentences.zh: 她说，好啊。

sentences.en: So, I'm like, all right.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧。

sentences.en: What you making?
sentences.zh: 你在做什么菜呢？

sentences.en: So, we had this very simple, innocent, sweet conversation.
sentences.zh: 于是我们就进行了这样一场非常简单、单纯、甜美的对话。

sentences.en: It was just so amazing.
sentences.zh: 真的是太棒了。

sentences.en: And I hung up the phone at the end of it.
sentences.zh: 挂断电话的那一刻，我把电话放下了。

sentences.en: And I looked at my husband.
sentences.zh: 我看着我丈夫。

sentences.en: And he said, wow.
sentences.zh: 他说，哇。

sentences.en: And I said, that was just the best day of my life.
sentences.zh: 我说，这简直是我生命中最美好的一天。

sentences.en: I just had the best day of my life.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚度过了生命中最美好的一天。

sentences.en: I can't believe she called me.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信她给我打电话了。

sentences.en: Well, the next day, she called me at 5 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 嗯，第二天，她在5点钟又给我打了电话。

sentences.en: And the next, and the next, and the next.
sentences.zh: 然后是接下来的那一天，再下一天，又一天。

sentences.en: And I have to say that she and I have been cooking together on FaceTime probably like four to five nights a week.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，她和我现在差不多每周有四到五天都在FaceTime上一边做饭一边聊天。

sentences.en: We pour a little glass of wine.
sentences.zh: 我们倒上一小杯红酒。

sentences.en: Sometimes my husband gets involved.
sentences.zh: 有时候我丈夫会加入。

sentences.en: Sometimes her husband.
sentences.zh: 有时候她丈夫也会加入。

sentences.en: Sometimes we have a four-way conversation.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们会进行四人通话。

sentences.en: We don't have deep, crazy conversations where sometimes we have actual probably a minute or two,
sentences.zh: 我们其实并没有进行什么深刻、疯狂的交谈，有时候我们甚至会有大概一两分钟、

sentences.en: almost three minutes of complete silence where we're just sort of side by side on the phone in silence.
sentences.zh: 甚至将近三分钟的完全沉默，我们只是在电话里并肩享受着沉默。

sentences.en: And I think those silences are the sweetest moments in our conversations, which sounds strange.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些沉默是我们对话中最甜蜜的时刻，听起来可能有点奇怪。

sentences.en: But we've spent so much time together that we have those comfortable, comforting silences as we share family recipes.
sentences.zh: 但我们在一起花了太多时间，以至于在分享家常菜谱时，拥有了这种舒适、慰藉的沉默。

sentences.en: My daughter died in a way.
sentences.zh: 我的女儿在某种意义上死去了。

sentences.en: And then my daughter was reborn again the day that she made the phone call.
sentences.zh: 然后我的女儿在她打来那通电话的日子里又重生了。

sentences.en: My son, who has always struggled with physical milestones, learned to ride a bike.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子一直在身体发育的关键节点上遇到困难，他学会骑自行车了。

sentences.en: It was the most amazing thing.
sentences.zh: 这真的是最神奇的事情。

sentences.en: There's a parking lot not far from us.
sentences.zh: 我们离这不远有一个停车场。

sentences.en: And we would go there every day and just get Luke to practice.
sentences.zh: 我们每天都会去那里让卢克练习。

sentences.en: And after several weeks, he finally figured out how to do it.
sentences.zh: 经过好几个星期，他终于学会怎么骑了。

sentences.en: And it would never have happened if it wasn't for the pandemic, because usually our lives are so busy and maybe we would go once a weekend.
sentences.zh: 如果不是因为疫情，这绝对不可能发生，因为平时我们的生活太忙了，可能一周也就去一次。

sentences.en: But what he really needed was us to go every single day.
sentences.zh: 但他真正需要的是我们每天都陪着去。

sentences.en: And it finally happened.
sentences.zh: 最后终于成功了。

sentences.en: And it was just pure magic.
sentences.zh: 那简直是纯粹的魔法。

sentences.en: The bad part is that a couple of months later, he completely face-planted and we ended up having to go to the emergency room.
sentences.zh: 糟糕的是，几个月后，他结结实实地摔了个脸朝地，我们最后不得不去急诊室。

sentences.en: But he does still ride his bike even after that.
sentences.zh: 但他经历过那次之后，现在依然在骑自行车。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: So one of the best things about 2020 for me is my family getting a pet kitty.
sentences.zh: 所以2020年对我来说最棒的事情之一，就是我们全家养了一只宠物小猫。

sentences.en: She was, she's so amazing that I feel like sometimes COVID isn't here.
sentences.zh: 她太棒了，以至于有时候我觉得新冠根本不存在。

sentences.en: It's just the longest weekend ever.
sentences.zh: 这只是史上最长的一个周末而已。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what I like about 2020 is we have a baby set and friends across the street.
sentences.zh: 所以2020年我喜欢的一点是，街对面有一家日托和朋友。

sentences.en: We also have a bubble with them.
sentences.zh: 我们跟他们也是一个防疫社交泡泡。

sentences.en: My grandmother was born in China in 1920.
sentences.zh: 我外祖母1920年出生于中国。

sentences.en: She's lived through war, famine, revolution, and one of the deadliest earthquakes in recorded history in Tangshan, China.
sentences.zh: 她经历过战争、饥荒、革命，还有中国唐山那场有记录以来最致命的大地震之一。

sentences.en: She lives a really quiet life with my parents in Indiana.
sentences.zh: 她和我的父母在印第安纳州过着非常平静的生活。

sentences.en: And this year, because of COVID, my dad got a ping pong table because he really loves to play, but couldn't go anywhere to play.
sentences.zh: 今年因为疫情，我爸爸买了一张乒乓球桌，因为他真的很喜欢打球，但又哪儿也去不了。

sentences.en: And they discovered, after getting the table, that my grandmother could play and she loves it.
sentences.zh: 买完球桌后他们发现，我外祖母居然也会打，而且她很喜欢。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Lauren Jacobson and I am a touring musician.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫劳伦·雅各布森，我是一名巡演音乐人。

sentences.en: And one night, two houses down, we saw that a teenage girl was playing violin in her front yard.
sentences.zh: 有一天晚上，在隔了两栋房子的远处，我们看到一个十几岁的女孩在她的前院拉小提琴。

sentences.en: Let me take my music off.
sentences.zh: 让我把我的音乐关掉。

sentences.en: Tell me about the first night that we met.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲我们第一次遇见的那个晚上吧。

sentences.en: Okay, let's see.
sentences.zh: 好，让我想想。

sentences.en: So my mom had asked me to play like a little concert for her after like the 8 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈让我为她演奏一场小型音乐会，大约在晚上8点钟鼓掌致敬活动之后什么的。

sentences.en: cheer or whatever.
sentences.zh: 欢呼什么的。

sentences.en: And you walked by and you knew the piece that I was playing.
sentences.zh: 然后你走了过来，你认出了我正在拉的那首曲子。

sentences.en: And then we decided to play the double block.
sentences.zh: 接着我们决定一起拉这首双小提琴曲。

sentences.en: I wanted to play first violin.
sentences.zh: 我想拉第一小提琴。

sentences.en: And so did you.
sentences.zh: 你也是这么想的。

sentences.en: So I switched to second and it's not too bad for our first time back.
sentences.zh: 所以我换到了第二声部，对于我们重归演奏的第一天来说，这感觉还算不错。

sentences.en: It's been awesome playing with you.
sentences.zh: 跟你一起演奏真是太棒了。

sentences.en: I'm glad we found each other.
sentences.zh: 很高兴我们找到了彼此。

sentences.en: You ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 开始吧。

sentences.en: COVID has been hard.
sentences.zh: 疫情一直很艰难。

sentences.en: Honestly, the worst year for my family.
sentences.zh: 说实话，对我的家庭来说这是最糟糕的一年。

sentences.en: For most folks I know, for most of the world, it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 对我知道的大多数人来说，对全世界大部分人来说，似乎都是如此。

sentences.en: It was and I guess still is such a weird year and also a sad year.
sentences.zh: 过去是，而且我想现在依然是如此诡异的一年，同时也是悲伤的一年。

sentences.en: But say hi.
sentences.zh: 不过打个招呼吧。

sentences.en: Do you want to say something?
sentences.zh: 你想说点什么吗？

sentences.en: Very exciting.
sentences.zh: 太令人兴奋了。

sentences.en: But today I'm happy and I'm crying.
sentences.zh: 但今天我很开心，而且我在哭泣。

sentences.en: Just sharing this.
sentences.zh: 只是分享一下这个。

sentences.en: Every morning when I open my eyes, I think I get another day.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨当我睁开双眼，我都觉得我又赚到了一天。

sentences.en: And I'm so humbly grateful.
sentences.zh: 我内心充满卑微的感激。

sentences.en: I am very grateful for the life I have.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激我所拥有的生活。

sentences.en: And I'm really thankful.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常感恩。

sentences.en: So yay!
sentences.zh: 所以，耶！

sentences.en: Congratulations!
sentences.zh: 恭喜！

sentences.en: Congratulations!
sentences.zh: 恭喜！

sentences.en: Thank you!
sentences.zh: 谢谢！

sentences.en: Yay!
sentences.zh: 耶！

sentences.en: As bad as 2020 has been, I think there have been a lot of beautiful moments of people connecting with each other.
sentences.zh: 尽管2020年如此糟糕，但我认为也有很多人们彼此连接的美好时刻。

sentences.en: And I think in reaching out, we reach to save ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在向他人伸出援手的同时，我们也是在拯救自己。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: It's a year I'll never forget.
sentences.zh: 这是我永远不会忘记的一年。

sentences.en: So, uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，呃，是的。

sentences.en: Not all bad.
sentences.zh: 也不完全是坏事。

sentences.en: Glory be to God.
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝。

sentences.en: It's going to end.
sentences.zh: 这一切就要结束了。

sentences.en: 2020 is going to end with great thanksgiving and great love and support from family and friends.
sentences.zh: 2020年将伴随着巨大的感恩，以及来自家人和朋友的巨大爱意与支持画上句号。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家的聆听。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: My name is Nick Schwartz.
sentences.zh: 我叫尼克·施瓦茨。

sentences.en: I live in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 我住在芝加哥。

sentences.en: And one small thing that's brought me and my friends some joy this year has been my Michael
sentences.zh: 今年有一件小事给我和朋友们带来了一些快乐，那就是我对迈克尔·巴尔巴罗（Michael Barbaro）的模仿。

sentences.en: Barbaro impression.
sentences.zh: 模仿巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: So I listen every day.
sentences.zh: 所以我每天都听。

sentences.en: And for some reason, at the end of every episode, in my head, I would say, that's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，在每一集节目的最后，我脑海里都会说：以上就是本期的全部内容（That's it for The Daily）。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·明天。

sentences.en: See you, Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 再见，巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Hey, is this Nick?
sentences.zh: 嘿，这是尼克吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是。

sentences.en: Hey, Nick, it's Michael Barbaro from The Daily.
sentences.zh: 嘿，尼克，我是《每日秀》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: I'm doing excellent.
sentences.zh: 我非常好。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你怎么样？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: It's really good to hear your voice.
sentences.zh: 听到你的声音真高兴。

sentences.en: So based on your success in mimicking Michael Barbaro, we thought we would ask you to read the credits at the end of the show.
sentences.zh: 所以基于你模仿迈克尔·巴巴罗的成功，我们想请你在节目结束时读一下制作人员名单。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Well, let's do that.
sentences.zh: 那我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Luke Vanderbluk, Ashtar Chatterbeady, Bianca Gaper, Hans Buto, and Sydney Harper, with help from Rochelle Bonja.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卢克·范德布卢克、阿什塔·查特伯迪、比安卡·加珀、汉斯·布托和悉尼·哈珀制作，罗谢尔·邦贾提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Wendy Doerr and engineered by Brad Fisher.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由温迪·多尔剪辑，布拉德·费舍尔担任音响工程师。

sentences.en: Original music by Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 原创音乐由丹·鲍威尔创作。

sentences.en: What is this, like an audio mirror?
sentences.zh: 这是什么，就像一面音频镜子吗？

sentences.en: There's no flaws.
sentences.zh: 没有任何瑕疵。

sentences.en: There's no flaws from you in any of this.
sentences.zh: 你在这里面没有任何瑕疵。

sentences.en: Bravo.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日秀》全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·明天。

sentences.en: See you, Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 再见，巴巴罗。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一群自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
